input.notes: Flow runs entirely in the content iframe of main.html. Enter the member number in the Member ID field on the Member Inquiry form and click Search; the Member Summary screen shows Name and an accounts table. Share Savings is the row with description "Share Savings" (suffix 00); its Balance cell is the value extracted. Note the accounts table row order/count can vary by member, so the Share Savings row should be matched by description rather than fixed position. Interstitials that may appear: member_alert (requires a human — call request_help), system_notice, service_unavailable, session_expired, signed_out.
